notes: Spec section 2.5.1 requires an explicit empty timing-choice contract when no ideal timing choice is modeled; an omitted or absent object is not that instance.
Every instruction transition is assigned the one fixed public latency class lat.fixed.1; that assignment introduces no timing choice.

This is a CandidateOnly harness mirror of TimingEnvironmentContract, not a canonical SPS-TimingEnvironment interface: timingEnvironmentId and versionAndObservationBoundary digests do not exist for a candidate bundle.
